<!-- pr-reviewer: 487a508e8988823ee590052d8d6ecb780e7d59e3 -->
Review: clean, no blockers (static review, not built).
- Every crate (app, motion, post, sim, ui) uses serde_json = { workspace = true }; no crate pins its own, so the feature applies everywhere.
- float_roundtrip only changes the f64 parser to exact, correctly rounded; the writer and the file format are unchanged, so existing project files load the same except that previously 1-ulp-off values now parse exactly. Cargo.lock needs no change: the feature adds no dependency (serde_json 1.0.154 already locked).
- Tests: the off-round stock placement (-14.966666666666667) asserts bit equality after save/load and that the loaded op is not Stale; the mesh test checks vertex bits. The APIs they call exist (from_mesh, location_of, facets_of, find_by_name, cube). Nit: the mesh test would likely pass without the feature too; the stock test is the one that pins the fix.
